note: Svalbard has no visa regime for entry, residence or work (the Svalbard Treaty), and no stay limit; but it is reached almost only through mainland Norway, which asks a Schengen visa of those who need one (the route isn't modelled here).

sources.title: The Governor of Svalbard (Sysselmesteren), Entry and residence
sources.said: Foreigners do not need a visa or work and residence permits from the Norwegian authorities to travel to Svalbard. However, foreign citizens with a visa requirement for the Schengen Area must have a Schengen visa when travelling to and from Svalbard via mainland Norway. It’s important to ensure that you get a double-entry visa so you can return to the Schengen Area (mainland Norway) after your stay in Svalbard.
